```{r}
library(corrplot)
theta <- read.csv('Data/summary/theta.csv')
corr <- as.matrix(read.csv("Data/summary/corr.csv", row.names = 1))

corrplot(corr, method = 'color')
par(mfrow = c(2, 5))  
for (task in colnames(theta)) {
  hist(theta[[task]], main = task, xlab = "Score", col = "skyblue", border = "white",n = 10)
}
par(mfrow = c(1, 1))
```
